nextProject.thumbnailExcerpt: A smashing brand for Johor Bahru's premier tennis school.
nextProject.title: Summer Smash Tennis

children.text: Summer Smash Tennis is Johor Bahru’s premier tennis academy. We served up a new brand and website to help them ace the space.
The coaches at Summer Smash Tennis are dedicated to helping people Play Beautifully.

For them, tennis is more than a sport. It’s an opportunity for players to be part of a community, grow as individuals, and—most of all—have some fun.

In reimagining the brand, we knew we wanted to capture that same welcoming, uplifting spirit.

The brandmark and colour palette is inspired by retro summer camps and sunny Johor Bahru afternoons. Stickers and mixed media graphics transform photos into heightened moments of playfulness, serving as a reminder to see the joy in every swing.

In addition to the brand, we also rebuilt the Summer Smash website from the ground up.

A refreshed information architecture ensures class information is readily accessible, and custom CMS plugins make updates more manageable for the admin team. Moments of joy are interspersed throughout the site to elevate the user experience and better reflect the level of quality on offer.

Since launch, Summer Smash Tennis has seen more than a 50% increase in class registrations.

work.thumbnailExcerpt: Rebranding the world's largest social platform for investors and traders.
work.title: Stocktwits

children.text: As the original creators of the “$cashtag”, Stocktwits has been a pioneer in blending social interaction and investing. We partnered with their team to create a reimagined identity that reflects the future of financial culture.

The financial industry is changing. Fast. And with over 10 million users, Stocktwits is the place that it's happening. But with a brand that looked better suited to the days when Facebook had walls and Twitter had normal human beings, it was time for an update.

We reimagined a brand built to reflect the pulse of the modern market and designed to resonate with the fast-moving, ever-evolving nature of today's investing culture. At the heart of the visual identity, the $cashtag, now contained within a speech bubble, frames Stocktwits as the ultimate space for connection, conversation, and community around finance.

The design system is unapologetic and modern, with bold typography and a vibrant colour palette that captures the intensity and energy of online financial communities. Infused with the same irreverent energy that turns market rallies into memes and trading losses into viral content, the identity commands attention whether it's breaking market news or dropping the hottest trading memes.
